violated_contract: A Grafana alert UID that live-alert-gate.json or the pusher finalization set requires must be applied by the reviewed monitoring import before any KeepLast business rule is written, and a later read-back must not treat Grafana-assigned query defaults as drift when the committed rule omits them. A workflow path filter that watches only live-stt.json leaves resilience.json KeepLast edits unprovisioned while the release gate still demands them.
canonical_prevention: The egress provision-live-alerts job imports every live-alert-gate.json UID on the same --mode import path as live-STT. Production upserts datasource canaries and reads them back before KeepLast business rules; development applies _development_rules (Error, no canaries). Definition comparison ignores only queryType "", model.intervalMs 1000, and model.maxDataPoints 43200 when the committed node omits them. A resilience.json change is on that workflow's path filter, and the following fleet check covers these UIDs.
